description: Translate one finished clip's burned-in captions into one of 19 languages and re-render it with them; word timings are kept and the original clip is preserved. Only the captions change: for a translated VOICE use katto_dub_clip. Creator feature (requires an active Creator subscription; otherwise an error with code upgrade_required and a pricing link to give the user). Does NOT use video quota. Not idempotent: each call starts a new render. Returns a rerender_id; poll katto_get_rerender until status is 'completed' for the new clip_url.
name: katto_translate_captions
